coordinateOrigin: top-left of the named source PNG; x increases right and y increases down; rectangles are source-pixel crops

categories.label: Ground and grass
categories.reading: PR grass has fine, dense pixel texture and broad value/color patches. The BEFORE map ground is brighter, with isolated high-frequency speckle. Compare fill texture and value grouping; the source frames use different zooms and cannot establish exact colors.

asset.gap: Candidate OpeningWorldV1 grass is available at 32x32 with repeat ports on all edges; compare it to PR texture. It is not integrated into the game.

categories.label: Ocean surface
categories.reading: PR water reads as continuous blue animated surface with fine light ripples. The supplied current capture is explicitly BEFORE the ocean fix and shows a strong regular grid/streak pattern; it is only a baseline, not evidence about the post-fix build.

asset.nativeSize: 32x32 tile, four-frame loop (128x32 strip or four 32x32 files)
asset.ports: seamless repeat north/east/south/west; phase-compatible neighboring tiles
asset.gap: Recompare against a post-fix native screenshot before changing water art.
asset.status: Existing art; renderer uses frozen unbuilt UV crop x=3..31; BEFORE screenshot predates it.

categories.label: Coast and beach
categories.reading: PR beaches form a very narrow, irregular tan fringe along the waterline. The BEFORE map has broad, blocky sandy steps. Keep the land silhouette as authored geography and add a thin edge/foam treatment without expanding land.

asset.ports: land/water edge orientation is carried separately; shoreline edge band is transparent over the water base
asset.gap: Eight directional existing shore tiles are available, while new coast art is planned under WorldComponentsV1. The active/unbuilt world contract uses water base plus a 20% shore-edge band; compare only after native QA.
asset.status: Existing edge tiles; new replacement planned under WorldComponentsV1; no native post-fix QA yet.

categories.label: Forest canopy and floor
categories.reading: PR forests are packed, separate dark conifers with pointed crowns and visible gaps between trees; forest floor remains a distinct green layer. The BEFORE map reads as a single mottled hedge mass.

asset.layer: forest-floor + two staggered conifer sprites per logical cell; town hedge canopy is separate
asset.ports: conifer sprites are transparent overlays; floor repeats; town hedge has its own edge/turn ports
asset.gap: Candidate conifer and renderer contract are available in OpeningWorldV1; test two staggered trees per logical cell against PR density. Art is not integrated into the game.
asset.status: Generated OpeningWorldV1 candidate; two staggered conifers per logical cell is a renderer contract; not game-integrated.

categories.label: Mountain peaks
categories.reading: PR mountains use repeated triangular peaks with crisp light-facing facets and dark separations. Only a narrow, partly UI-adjacent mountain strip is visible in the current BEFORE capture, so its full mountain treatment is not established.

asset.nativeSize: 32x32 peak tile set with straight edges and outer/inner corners; larger 2x2 clusters optional
asset.ports: solid peak center; cardinal/diagonal silhouette ports for connected ridgelines
asset.gap: Build separate peak and slope tiles; keep mountain outlines crisp and avoid noisy all-over rock fill.
asset.status: Existing mountain tiles; new visual variants planned under WorldComponentsV1; supplied BEFORE crop is too narrow for a full visual audit.

categories.label: River channel
categories.reading: PR rivers are narrow, winding blue channels with a thin green/brown bank and fine white highlights. The current capture shows a more tile-stepped blue stream with brown/orange borders; compare river width, bank continuity, and bends.

asset.nativeSize: 32x32 center, straight N/E/S/W, four bends, four tees, cross and mouth tiles
asset.ports: N/E/S/W water ports; bank overlay follows all exposed land edges
asset.gap: Provide every connectivity shape and keep water and bank as independently replaceable layers.
asset.status: Existing masks/frames encode river connectivity; new river-edge components planned under WorldComponentsV1; not game-integrated.

categories.label: River bridge

current.note: This crossing is partly under the top HUD in the supplied BEFORE view.

categories.reading: The PR crossing reads as a narrow gray stone span with a clear road deck and squared abutments. The existing AI-Art coast bridge candidates are wooden blue-plank tiles, so they should not be described as stone or assumed visually equivalent.

asset.nativeSize: 32x32 directional tile pair; 32x64 variant only if one-tile depth is insufficient
asset.ports: road ports at both bridge ends; river remains continuous under span; shore abutment ports on both banks
asset.gap: Generate a gray stone bridge pair and keep its deck separate from river and bank layers.
asset.status: Existing tiles are wood; PR reference shows gray stone. New stone bridge assets planned under WorldComponentsV1.

categories.label: Walled settlement marker
categories.reading: The PR Fynn map marker is a walled cluster of blue-roof buildings with an interior keep, not a lone house. The crop avoids most of the top-right minimap overlay. No walled settlement is visible in the supplied current BEFORE viewport, so this is a target-shape comparison only.

asset.layer: settlement wall + roof clusters + keep + gate
asset.ports: bottom-center anchor immediately above the gate cell; wall perimeter has a south gate opening
asset.gap: Candidate Altair 160x128 and Fynn 160x192 walled markers are available; align a bottom-center anchor above the gate. Art is not integrated into the game.

categories.label: Overworld actor
categories.reading: The PR overworld places a small party-leader sprite over terrain; the supplied current screenshot shows a visibly larger clustered avatar. Keep actor size/readability independent of land tiles, forest canopy, and UI.

asset.nativeSize: 16x24 per frame; 4 directions x idle/walk frames
asset.ports: bottom-center foot anchor; no terrain edge ports
asset.gap: Use a compact leader/party marker and preserve a separate foot anchor and animation sheet.
asset.status: Existing directional actor sheets; screenshot comparison is visual only.

categories.label: Screen-space map UI
categories.reading: The PR route captures include a top-right world-map inset. The current game has top objective/title/menu bars and a bottom control bar. These belong to screen-space UI, not the world terrain layer stack.

asset.nativeSize: layout-sized UI panel; not a terrain tile
asset.ports: anchors to viewport corners; independent of camera/world coordinates
asset.gap: Keep minimap and objective/control chrome outside all ground, coast, water, settlement, and actor passes.
